newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle prices not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle prices not tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers after a weekly movement of 104,600 head.
The last established price was 63.00 on Thursday. Friday's packer bids are 62.00-63.00 with asking prices 63.00-65.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - None Last week - 200 Year Ago - None
